facts.fact: The Central Bank of Nigeria issued circular PSS/DIR/PUB/CIR/001/004 on 15 June 2026, requiring banks, microfinance banks, mobile money operators, switches, payment terminal service providers, super agents and all licensed payment operators to store and manage payment transaction data generated in Nigeria within Nigeria by 1 January 2027.

The circular was issued by the Central Bank of Nigeria's Payments System Supervision Department (signed by its Director) for the payment institutions it licenses, with the localisation duty applying from 1 January 2027.

systems.owner: Central Bank of Nigeria, Payments System Supervision Department
